batch: T10-AUTH8C provenance-safe locators, fresh-observation handshake, real finishAuth
scope: Pure Node: real auth-adapters/auth-services, the real AUTH-6 flow, the real AUTH-5 private port and the real regression-locator over a labeled FakeSession, synthetic primitives, a labeled Fake RuntimeClient and labeled Fake services. No Playwright launch, browser, model, PG, Worker.once or deploy.

summary.note: Raw runner totals per file; flow/runtime/services cases first reported in earlier batches are re-runs, not new coverage. test/integration.test.mjs needs PG/Docker and is out of scope for these pure-Node runs.

provenanceFix.problem: The adapter re-based a target resolved against the session-s own fresh snapshot onto the snapshot the flow held, rewriting another snapshot id — which forges provenance even when page, node and frame happen to match.
now: a target is passed through only when it already belongs to the snapshot it is checked against; otherwise it is refused with TARGET_NOT_FOUND, never rewritten

the real session resolves against a fresh observation, so the adapter exposes an explicit handshake: resolveRegressionLocator, then the cached getSnapshot read of that same observation, with the target required to match that observation fully
the flow redacts the actual fresh observation through the private port (registered secrets only) and records it before the permit, then grants with that real snapshot id
without the cached snapshot read the adapter refuses to construct, so no run can grant or touch the browser
provenanceFix.negativeProof: Registering the raw observation instead of the port-redacted one fails 2 of the adapter cases (6/8), so the redaction step in the handshake is load-bearing.

locatorZeroMatch.change: regression-locator reports count === 0 as LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND (explicit absence) instead of LOCATOR_NOT_UNIQUE; multi-match, hidden and thrown failures keep their existing codes.
locatorZeroMatch.effect: the optional OTP target can now be distinguished: absence returns null (skip the OTP wait) while ambiguity still blocks with TARGET_AMBIGUOUS and never requests an OTP.

realFinish.wiring: AuthServiceClient.finishAuth(proof, sessionId, authStateId) is called with the frozen proof/session and the state ref this adapter captured; a ref it never captured is refused, and a client without the method stays SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with no ordinary-finish fallback.
realFinish.stubRule: unimplementedServices may only fill pauseForOtp; an injected finishAuth stub is ignored and the real method is used (asserted).
covered: successful run returns the captured stateRef and the finish call carries the frozen proof/session
a refusing finish blocks with its constant code, no success and no stateRef
a missing finish method stays SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with zero finish calls
the outcome of a successful run carries no leaseToken, ticket, password or gate id

commands: cd apps/worker && node --test test/auth-flow.test.mjs test/auth-runtime.test.mjs test/auth-services.test.mjs test/auth-adapters.test.mjs test/auth-redaction.test.mjs   # 37/37
interfaceNotesForRoot: Every locator resolution now registers one extra redacted observation (the fresh snapshot), so the server sees the id the permit targets before the grant.
The adapter refuses at construction if the session cannot read back the cached observation; the real BrowserSession has getSnapshot, so this only guards a partial session.
A zero-match locator now arrives as LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND: the OTP step skips, and a required target reports TARGET_NOT_RESOLVED.
finishAuth is private RuntimeClient.finishAuth(proof, sessionId, authStateId); the adapter never falls back to the ordinary finish and never lets a stub replace it.
notImplemented: import / OTP service / handoff remain absent: the OTP step still needs an explicit stub to proceed
no Worker.once or tick wiring; Stage.auth stays unwired
no PG or real Coordinator path in these runs; Root re-verifies the full chain on its own PG
actual browser / worker-entry / Ego stay paused
